title: Spark failures and recovery
hypothesis: Spark's task retries absorb an executor loss; the playbook fixes out-of-memory within 2 retries; adaptive execution handles skew.

arms.clean_baseline: no fault; the reference output checksum
arms.low_driver_memory: first attempt given 256m, so it must be raised to finish
arms.sandbox_container_killed: the sandbox container is killed mid-job
arms.skewed_one_customer_20pct: one account holds 20% of all order lines

config.shared_source_note: the first three arms read byte-identical source data, which is what makes the checksum comparison meaningful; the skew arm necessarily differs
